items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Right. How would you have distinguished them? You would have called Walter Page "Page" and Hot Lips "Hot Lips" or "Lips?" [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, call him "Lips."

ctx.x: Right. How would you have distinguished them? You would have called Walter Page "Page" and Hot Lips "Hot Lips" or "Lips?"
"Lips," right? Okay, "I don't mind saying that it was a mad scuffle with that band." Was it?
